releaseNotes:
## ✨ Improvements

### 🔄 Updates

- Added in-app update support, with checks at startup and in Settings. Downloading and installing updates requires user action, and installation is deferred while recording or unfinished work is active.

### 🎙️ Recording and Review

- Added recording timers.
- Improved meeting review controls, queue and dropdown feedback, and the notes status display.

## 🛠️ Fixes

- Fixed an issue where quitting the application could leave the processing queue paused on the next launch.
- Constrained automatic language detection during transcription.

## 💻 Compatibility

- Supports Windows 10 and 11, x64.
- Preserves existing recordings, transcripts, settings, credentials, and installed model locations during upgrades.
- Older installations without in-app updates require a manual installation of an updater-enabled release first.
